DerashaArchiveRecord.title: DerashaArchiveRecord
DerashaArchiveRecord.description: Archived Derasha study numbered sequentially (#1, #2, etc.) for historical search and cross-Derasha dialectical comparison.

ownerId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the study owner.

query.description: Original query or topic that generated the Derasha.

duration.description: Target speaking duration of the Derasha.

centralIdea.description: Core thesis or kavana central of the Derasha.

essaySummary.description: Full or summarized homiletical text for search and comparison.

sourcesSummary.description: Canonical Sefaria references and external sources cited.

ComparativeDerashaStudy.title: ComparativeDerashaStudy
ComparativeDerashaStudy.description: Dialectical comparison between two or more archived Derashot (e.g., #1 vs #5) analyzing relationship, contradiction, or complementarity.

ownerId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the study owner.

relationType.description: Analytical lens: RELACION, CONTRADICCION, COMPLEMENTO, or INTEGRAL.

comparedLabel.description: Human-readable label of compared Derashot (e.g. 'Derashá #1 vs Derashá #5').

userHypothesis.description: User observation or hypothesis about how the selected Derashot relate, contradict, or complement each other.

synthesisTitle.description: Title of the comparative dialectical synthesis.

executiveVerdict.description: Direct evaluation of the user hypothesis across the selected Derashot.

contradictionsAnalysis.description: Analysis of tensions or apparent contradictions (Machloket) between the Derashot.

complementarityAnalysis.description: Analysis of how the Derashot complement and enrich each other.

dialecticalResolution.description: Higher synthesis and homiletical integration of the compared Derashot.

/derashot_archive/{derashaId}.description: User-owned archived Derashot with sequential numbering (#1, #2, etc.) and full searchable metadata.

/comparative_studies/{studyId}.description: User-owned dialectical comparison studies between multiple archived Derashot.
